messages:
incidentbot: ALERT: notify-relay outgoing paging failures detected — multiple 500/502 responses from relay-proxy. 60s window, ~22 pages queued for retry. tagging @Michael H., @Luisa (on-call). paging_infra

Michael H.: saw it, looking now. did PD show any deliveries/acks?

Anya R.: PD shows no outbound webhook deliveries for the relay key in the last 10m — provider didn't receive anything.

Luisa (on-call): i didn't get any page or SMS. phone was on. no missed page in PD either.

Michael H.: tailing relay logs now — running: `kubectl -n notify logs -l app=notify-relay --since=15m | grep 502`

Michael H.: ```
2026-03-17T10:11:50Z relay-12 ERROR upstream response 502 "Bad Gateway" from proxy-10.2.3.4
2026-03-17T10:11:51Z relay-12 WARN retrying outbound page id=abcd1234
```

Ops Team: looks like proxy 10.2.3.4 started returning 502 after the auth token refresh at ~10:11:50 UTC.

Anya R.: is that the signing rotation we rolled yesterday? could be related to the new rotate logic.

Chris L.: i'm seeing header mangling in the proxy logs — Authorization header contains a stray newline that the carrier rejects. pushing a quick rollback to previous signing behavior.

Michael H.: restarting relay pods to clear in-flight failures: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/notify-relay -n notify`

incidentbot: ACTION: queued pages retried. summary: 22 attempts, 20 delivered, 2 failed (carrier timeout).

Luisa (on-call): confirm i just got pages for the earlier alerts. receiving now.

Anya R.: customer impact update: support has two reports from customers who missed pages (AcmeCorp, BrightData). impact window ~10:11–10:16 UTC. delay only, no message content corruption.

Michael H.: opened PD incident PD-4567 and tagged SRE + Escalations — https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4567 (internal)

Luisa (on-call): draft status page: "Paging relays experienced transient failures causing delayed outbound pages to some carriers between 10:11–10:16 UTC. Mitigated at 10:17 UTC via rollback. Investigating root cause and rolling key rotation fix." anyone want to edit before publish?

Chris L.: :thumbsup: publishing now to status page. pushed note to support with recommended manual send for any missed critical pages.

Ops Team: root cause: signing rotation produced a malformed Authorization header due to newline-stripping regression in proxy code path. PR #8345 contains the fix, will cut hotfix and schedule full rollout with canary checks.

Michael H.: moving to #postmortems to write RCA and timeline, will include logs and inflight metrics. tagging @eng-infra for follow-up on rotation gating.

Luisa (on-call): closing this thread — mitigation verified, customers notified, RCA follow-up scheduled. re-open if any further alerts. :white_check_mark:
